prompt.zh-TW: 海風民宿為了整修房舍買了不少設備，年底機器設備淨額 {{money:vars.ppe}}，非流動負債 {{money:vars.ncl}}，股東權益總額 {{money:vars.equity}}。依課程 Excel 口徑計算{{term:tm_8eyx0srs|plain}}，以百分比作答。算完想一想：這個數字高於或低於 {{percent:1|digits=0}} 各代表什麼？
prompt.en: Sea Breeze Guesthouse bought a lot of equipment to refurbish its rooms; at year end machinery and equipment (net) is {{money:vars.ppe}}, non-current liabilities are {{money:vars.ncl}} and total equity is {{money:vars.equity}}. Using the course Excel basis, what is the {{term:tm_8eyx0srs|plain}}? Answer as a percentage, then think: what would a figure above or below {{percent:1|digits=0}} mean?

explanation.zh-TW: 長期資金是 {{money:vars.equity}} 加 {{money:vars.ncl}}，除以 {{money:vars.ppe}}。{{term:tm_8eyx0srs}}低於 {{percent:1|digits=0}}，表示長期資金蓋不滿{{term:tm_gt8g4afe}}，差額只能靠一年內就要還的錢補上；借款到期時，設備卻還要用好幾年，這就是「以短支長」的壓力。
explanation.en: Long-term funds are {{money:vars.equity}} plus {{money:vars.ncl}}, divided by {{money:vars.ppe}}. A {{term:tm_8eyx0srs}} below {{percent:1|digits=0}} means long-term money does not fully cover the {{term:tm_gt8g4afe}}, so the gap has to be filled with money due within a year; when those loans fall due, the equipment still has years of use left, which is the pressure of funding long-lived assets with short-term money.
